prompts.prompt: What ordinary detail from this week would you like me to notice with you?
Which place helps your thoughts become quieter?
What simple pleasure have you become better at appreciating?
Which recent choice felt unmistakably like your own?
What kind of invitation makes you feel genuinely included?
Which hour of a perfect free day would you plan first?
What is something you enjoy more slowly than most people do?
Which object near you carries a story worth keeping?
What harmless opinion could you defend with unreasonable enthusiasm?
Which quality in a friend makes time together feel easy?
What small risk recently gave you more energy than fear?
Which part of your routine quietly reveals what matters to you?
When do you find it easiest to ask another person for help?
What kind of misunderstanding do you most want people to correct about you?
Which compliment feels meaningful because it notices effort rather than talent?
What do you protect when the rest of life becomes crowded?
Which past version of yourself deserves more kindness from you now?
What makes an apology feel complete enough to rebuild trust?
Where in your life are you learning to choose courage over control?
What does being emotionally generous mean without ignoring your own limits?
Which difference between two people can make a partnership stronger?
What kind of promise should be made rarely but kept carefully?
When have you felt seen without needing to explain everything?
What helps you stay open when an important conversation becomes uncomfortable?
Which shared responsibility can become an expression of care?
What would you want us to remember during a season when we feel out of sync?
How should two people protect each other's individual growth?
Which future uncertainty feels easier when imagined as a team?
What would make our home feel emotionally safe on a difficult day?
How do you hope we respond when one person's dream changes direction?
Which form of everyday affection do you never want us to outgrow?
What truth should remain speakable between us even when it is inconvenient?
How would you like us to celebrate progress that nobody else can see?
Which relationship habit could help us stay curious years from now?
What would a life that feels rich to both of us include besides achievement?
After these questions, what is one part of me you want to keep discovering?
